同一类任务，三种做法：判断一封邮件是不是垃圾邮件: One task, three approaches: is this email spam?
就拦截。机器只是执行。: , block it. The machine just executes.
第二级：机器学规则: Level 2: the machine learns the rules
给它一万个已标注邮件，权重自己调。: Give it ten thousand labelled emails; the weights tune themselves.
第三级：机器自己干: Level 3: the machine does it alone
没有任何标注，自己发现邮件的类别。: No labels at all; it finds the email categories itself.
规则系统：智能全在人写的规则里。: Rule system: all the intelligence is in human-written rules.
规则穷不尽：换一种写法就漏拦。: Rules never end: reword it and the filter misses it.
学习系统：智能从样例里长出来。: Learning system: intelligence grows out of examples.
人只给原料（数据）和判卷标准。: People supply only the raw material (data) and the marking scheme.
常住在这两级之上：: AI lives mostly on these two levels:
它不但会判断，还会产出新东西。: it not only judges, it produces something new.
